feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Work to clear 18,000 tonnes of waste from notorious site begins
articles.summary: An operation has started to remove 18,000 tonnes of waste from an illegal site in Wigan.

articles.title: Has the weather broken records where you live? Try our new tool
articles.summary: Storms Austen and Boelo striking different parts of the UK at the same time contributed to 24 October being one of the wettest days Britain has ever seen.

articles.title: Meghan pulls out of speech with Harry
articles.summary: Meghan has pulled out of a planned speech because she does not feel emotionally strong enough for public speaking after her father's arrest, Sky News understands.

articles.title: Retail sector charity refuses to back Poundland owner's boss
articles.summary: Britain's leading retail charity has refused to give its public backing to the executive at the centre of the Poundland insolvency crisis amid intense political scrutiny of the US investment firm's conduct.

articles.title: Civil servant who juggled up to five government jobs guilty of fraud
articles.summary: A civil servant has been found guilty of nine counts of fraud after using remote working and sick notes to juggle up to five full-time government jobs at the same time.

articles.title: Fire that killed mother, children and family dog 'caused by electrical appliances'
articles.summary: A mother, her two children, and the family dog were killed after a fire believed to have been caused by electrical appliances engulfed their home on Boxing Day, an inquest heard.

articles.title: Ex-teacher who sent racist emails to Kemi Badenoch jailed
articles.summary: A former school teacher who sent Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch racist emails and claimed to have been a member of the IRA has been jailed.

articles.title: James Bulger's mother 'relieved' as killer to remain in prison
articles.summary: James Bulger's mother has spoken of her overwhelming relief after the Parole Board said one of her son's killers should stay in prison.

articles.title: Killer couple both now dead and take secret of victim's remains to the grave
articles.summary: Two killers who murdered a vulnerable woman have both now died - taking the secret of where they hid their victim's remains to the grave.

articles.title: Ground Force presenter Tommy Walsh has died
articles.summary: Ground Force presenter Tommy Walsh has died at the age of 69 following a "long illness", his agent has confirmed.
